keyword_screen.method: Bounded author scan of all eight rendered pages with text spans/font names/coordinates and true column/full-width-table boundaries. Meaningful chapter/subsection headings, Tables35-1 through35-10 named rows and selected medical comment headwords, Figures35-1 through35-3 named scales/descriptor families, and lexical heads from MinionPro-Bold clauses explicitly mapped. Regular table/figure cells and selected regular technique names are not falsely described as bold. No exhaustive generic body-word inventory or clinical coverage claim. Case/whitespace/wrap joins normalized; duplicate casefold-term+page records merge emphasis notes.

source_wording_notes.normalization: Case/whitespace and wrap joins only. Table35-1 source prints drug- at line end then seeking behavior on next line; recorded drug-seeking behavior preserves its conventional hyphen. This is a spelling join, NOT nominalization or invented wording. Source/source aliases pethidine, paracetamol and acetylsalicylic acid are not separate discoveries.
source_wording_notes.qualifiers: Transdermal fentanyl/buprenorphine map to their drug-name entries without new formulation cues. Broader reuses remove long-QT length, rich-gentleman/purse, secret-agent, abdominal-pump/thought and pain-relief mute modifiers as applicable.
source_wording_notes.ket_family: Ketamine and ketoprofen share kettle alone; ketorolac adds lock. These taught partial-name fragments are NOT unique identifiers and do NOT assert drug equivalence. If names co-occur in an actual lesson they need disambiguating context/qualifiers and testing before use; none supplied as clinical teaching here.
source_wording_notes.nickname: Nitrous oxide laughing-mask cue is ONLY a learned cultural nickname association, not an assertion the drug causes laughter or any effect.
source_wording_notes.history: Earlier holds/rejections in older banks and workshops stay intact, even where a later retained root is reused. Resolved_holds contains actual entry terms only; batch/root notes live separately in reconciliation_history.

review_status: Author-completed bounded offline screen. Main independently reviewing integration/source/cues and owns shared tests, held register, ledger, index, handoff and Git. AI reviews are not credentialed human, clinical, pronunciation, recall or rendering validation.
coverage_limits: Bounded meaningful headings/table/emphasis screen, not every generic body noun, every table-comment word, exhaustive clinical coverage or proof of chapter completeness.
No PDF annotations found does not exclude flattened publisher highlighting. Colored headings and table shading are layout, not asserted user highlights.
Selected regular nonpharmacologic names on7/8 are expressly not bold. Numeric dose/score/conversion and full clinical statements excluded after lexical screening.
Familiar props/categories, actions and partial names need eventual taught recognition and recall testing. Shared KET fragments and code/morph families require context, not blind uniqueness claims.
